requirements: Midnight inclusive to 14:00 exclusive America/Los_Angeles; only one active console session
Complete process-name snapshot; recognized games and game streaming runtimes cause hold
Mouse, keyboard, browser use and a connected controller alone do not cause hold
Only owned generation descendants stop on detected game, window boundary, unknown process inventory, monitoring gap or clock jump
stopPolicy: Stop only the anonymous Job Object created for the stage. Keep completed receipts; interrupted jobs require inspection before retry. Do not remove stale locks without verifying their recorded PIDs exited.
detectionLimit: Process-name markers identify recognized games, not every possible game. No protected executable paths, CIM, foreground or input queries are used.
crossSessionPolicy: Require sole active console session. No cross-process session or executable-path queries.
